description: Natural play: the enterWindow policy climbs the cans, fence and a clothes line and drops into an open window; the capture logs its key presses; checkpoints in the alley and the first 200 passes of the room it reaches.

emulator.name: dosbox-automation
emulator.launch: C:\CAT.EXE from the shell, C: = game/ (read-only), PSP 01E5

startState: program entry CS:0000 after a clean launch; environment values come from the capture stream
keyInjection: at sync points, by writing the memory effects of the game INT 9 handler (CS:14b3)

dsExclude.reason: CS:5ac2 stores a PIT ch0 sample (sound timing only)
CS:5ac2 sweep value advanced per PIT-timed step (sound only)
CS:5a1c PIT sample and retune counter (sound only)
CS:5a1c sweep accumulators advanced per PIT-timed retune (sound only)

environmentChanges: CRTC vertical retrace moved from lines 412-414 to 405-410 at the first sync point (capture-only; values are recorded)
